Features
Everything for your big day
From your first guest invite to your last dance, Union Vault keeps every detail in one beautiful place.
Guest List & RSVP
Track every guest, dietary requirement, RSVP status, and plus-one. Filter and export at any time.
Budget Planner
Set a total budget, track spending per category, log payments, and see exactly where you stand.
Seating Planner
Build tables, drag-and-drop guests into seats, and handle family groupings with ease.
Vendor Manager
Store vendor contacts, quotes, contracts, and payment status all in one place.
Wishing Well
Track gifts and monetary contributions, send thank-you notes, and manage gift acknowledgements.
Cloud Sync
Your planner saves to the cloud automatically. Access from any device, any time — nothing is ever lost.
